subtitle: Merge clay before it dries
description:
Wheelthrown is a merge puzzle set in a potter's studio. Lumps of wet clay land on your board one after another. Drag a piece onto a matching piece to throw them together into something bigger: lumps become pinch pots, then cups, bowls, jugs and vases, and two vases make a grand amphora that is fired, glazed and set on your shelf.

The catch: clay dries. Every piece slowly fades from glossy terracotta to pale, cracked bone-dry, and bone-dry clay can't be moved or merged. Every merge splashes water onto the pieces around it, keeping them wet and even bringing dried pieces back. Where you merge matters as much as what you merge.

The clay arrives faster the longer you last. When the board is full and the next lump has nowhere to land, the session is over. Chain quick merges for bonus points, rescue dried pieces, fire as many amphorae as you can and beat your best score.

Every pot you fire counts toward your studio for good. Fire enough and new glazes unlock for your shelf.

Plays offline. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.
promo: Merge wet clay into cups, jugs, vases and amphorae before it dries. Every merge splashes the pieces around it. Fill your shelf.
reviewNote: Tap to start. Drag a clay piece onto an identical piece to merge them into the next pot; drop it on an empty square to move it. Pieces that dry out (pale and cracked) are stuck until a merge next to them wets them again. The game ends when the board is full.
